'''Carrot Seeds''' are a type of seed. Mature plants yield [[Carrot]]s.

They cannot be purchased using {{Name|Gold|class=inline}} from any traditional store, and are instead found in various other ways:<ref name="raccoonseeds" />
* Digging up [[Seed Spot]]s.
* Completing [[Giant Stump|Raccoon]] requests.
* Trading at the [[Giant Stump#Raccoon Wife's Shop|Raccoon Wife's Shop]] for 1 {{Name|Maple Seed|class=inline}}.
* Catching [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]] (7% chance).<ref name="chestchance" />
* Using the [[Seed Maker]].
* As the first prize from the Prize Machine in the [[Mayor's Manor]].
* Opening [[Mystery Box]]es or [[Golden Mystery Box]]es.
* Breaking open [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]] in [[the Mines]], [[Skull Cavern]], or [[Volcano Dungeon]] (2% chance).<ref name="containerchance" />
* Slaying [[Iridium Golem]]s (50% chance).<ref name="golemchance" />

All methods, other than trading at the Raccoon Wife's Shop and using the Seed Maker, only yield Carrot Seeds between [[Winter]] 21 and [[Spring]] 23.

==Tailoring==
Carrot Seeds are not used in any [[tailoring]]. They can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. They can also be used as a brown dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

'''Garlic Seeds''' are a type of seed. Mature plants yield [[Garlic]].

They can be purchased at [[Pierre's General Store]] starting in year 2, from the Magic Shop Boat at the [[Night Market]] on Winter 15 (starting in year 2), and occasionally from the [[Traveling Cart]]. They can also be obtained by using the [[Seed Maker]].  Five to twenty Garlic Seeds may occasionally be found in [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] in the Skull Cavern.

'''Strawberry Seeds''' are a type of seed. Mature plants yield [[Strawberry|Strawberries]].

They can be purchased for {{Price|100}} at the [[Egg Festival]], on the first and third days of the [[Desert Festival]] from the [[Desert Festival#Calico Egg Merchant|Calico Egg Merchant]] for {{Price|5|Calico}} and {{Price|6|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s respectively, or from [[Maru]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the Desert Festival. They can also be obtained by using the [[Seed Maker]].

When harvested, each Strawberry plant gives 1 Strawberry every 4 days, with a small random chance for more Strawberries.<ref name="extraharvest" />

==Notes==
<references>
<ref name="extraharvest">The game generates a random number between 0 and 1, and if it is less than 0.02, then another Strawberry will spawn.  This repeats until the random number is greater than or equal to 0.02, at which point the chance for an extra Strawberry ends.  Daily [[Luck]] can double the amount of extra Strawberries spawned by the above formula.</ref>
</references>
*Unlike most other types of seed, Strawberry Seeds have no sell value. Therefore, unlike other multi-harvest crops, it is not profitable to process the crops with a [[Seed Maker]].
